named_question: Can the already supported recount-moods repair expose its exact Num transition without writing, while preserving the existing writer and ordered admission?

existing_source_basis.relationship: Existing CLI count-only repair, direct-container selection, signed32 comparison and raw no-op preservation remain unchanged.
Existing collection Num-limited reader, separate Outputs fields and vector-size count assignments; not a new native UI operation.
Immutable prerequisite preview and output/early-return conventions only. No creation defaults or allocation enter this count-only operation.
Immutable earlier presence/spelling and read-only dispatch conventions. Historical rejected-command lists describe their own delivery, not this new audited path.

canonical_sources.relationship: Existing collection reader/emitter binds Num separately from Outputs and iterates Num; no new native malformed-count interpretation.
Existing append assigns Num from actual scene-vector size. Other append work is not reproduced by this repair.
Existing reconciliation assigns Num from vector size; identity reconciliation and empty-scene defaults remain outside this CLI operation.
Existing vector insertion used by the collection reader grows logical size through its existing helper.
Existing collection copy assigns Num from source vector size independently of copied Outputs. No full native copy/save transaction claim.

source_verification: Frozen latest.json identities, existing canonical code/functions/0xADDRESS.c bodies and decompile-index hash verified locally; prior artifacts and all contract artifact references verified from committed Git LF blobs, not working-tree CRLF. No new extraction, vendor text or private project data.

CLI_policy.operation: lox config lighting recount-moods FILE BLOCK --dry-run [--room ROOM] [--save-as PATH]
CLI_policy.shared_plan: One immutable private LightingMoodCountPlan supplies preview_lighting_mood_count and existing recount_lighting_moods. It contains the collection path and typed preview/report. The writer applies only its planned Num when changed and returns the original LightingMoodCountEdit shape. No cloned DOM, writer-then-discard, public reapply API or generic framework.
CLI_policy.ordered_admission: Existing conflicting-room guard precedes file/archive load and XML parsing. Existing require_one resolution, room filtering and ambiguity handling precede exact LightController2 type, exactly-one-direct-LightscenesC shape, direct LightsceneC counting and checked usize-to-i32 overflow. Existing signed32 Num parse determines changed; no new guard, normalization or parser.
CLI_policy.count: Count all direct LightsceneC records, even duplicate identities; ignore nested lookalike records and collections. Repair absent, empty, invalid, out-of-range, negative or stale Num to the decimal direct count. Equivalent signed32 spelling such as 0002 or +2 is retained exactly with changed=false. Empty direct collections count as zero without creating defaults.
CLI_policy.output: JSON flattens the unchanged before/after/scenes/changed report and adds dry_run, optional trace_id, scope stored_mood_count_repair, actual stored controller_uuid/controller_title, controller-relative collection_path XML child-node indices, before_effective and after_effective. before_effective is the existing signed32 parse, null when absent/invalid/out-of-range and negative when stored negative; it is not a native loaded-row count, default, clamp or width. after is actual planned storage, including original no-op spelling. Table quotes raw strings; CSV has presence columns distinguishing absent/empty/invalid and quoted escaping. Quiet suppresses only table summary; no-header only headers. Normal writer output is unchanged.
CLI_policy.preservation: Preview returns before mutation, saving, serialization, defaults, document stamping or any destination handling on success, failure and no-op. No input/existing/new destination, missing parent, directory, cache or telemetry writes, and no network requests. Actual execution retains existing in-place no-op byte/mtime preservation and explicit save-as behavior. Both Outputs fields, absent/sparse Qn, identities/SID/CID/UUID, record/attribute order, references, Name/SName, HCL, LSConfig, sequences, unknown storage and all existing writer defaults/save semantics are unchanged.
CLI_policy.dispatch: Only existing LightingCmd::RecountMoods newly enters the global dry-run allowlist. Unrelated unplanned local/live/deployment mutations remain rejected before dispatch and startup side effects.
CLI_policy.destination_limit: Preview ignores destination handling entirely; it does not promise writability, directory creation, serialization success, final-save/native-import behavior or eventual write success.
